nodes.label: Promote Workflow (beta to stable)
nodes.rationale: Promotes a soaked prerelease to stable with no rebuild: the exact artifacts beta users tested become stable by moving the :latest image tag via imagetools (preserving the multi-arch manifest), flipping the GitHub release to latest, and force-pushing the tag's commit to the production branch stable clients track.

nodes.label: Promotion Cascade (older betas flipped to stable)
nodes.rationale: Every non-draft prerelease older than the promoted target is also flipped to stable (never marked latest), oldest first, so no beta is ever left lingering as a prerelease below the new stable.
